name: Heinrich Böll Foundation: Sur-Place Scholarship Programme
summary: Since 1997, the Heinrich Böll Foundation supports graduates from Latin America through its Sur-Place Programme in Mexico. The programme aims at strengthening and professionalising the expert and leadership potential in Central America.
